evidence.reason: The admission hold relies on a durable marker: acquire() creates the marker with O_CREAT and fsyncs the token file, and the recovery path treats marker ownership as persistent evidence. But it never fsyncs the parent directory after creating the marker, so a power loss can lose the directory entry even though the token file was synced, allowing reboot without the hold; release has the analogous risk of an unsynced unlink leaving a stale hold. This is an ordinary durability defect in existing admission behavior, not a new hardening requirement. The fix is routine: fsync the parent directory after creation and after removal, and report an unverifiable transition if that sync fails.
